newsitem.title: USA: Time Warner Q1 shows growth in key areas.
newsitem.headline: Time Warner Q1 shows growth in key areas.

text.p: Time Warner Inc first quarter earning figures, issued on Wednesday, showed growth in key segments but continued weakness in its music division.
Warner Music Group posted first quarter earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization of $140 million vs $146 million for the same period in the prior year.
Music revenues dropped to $933 million from $983 million despite holding a lead in the U.S. market share with 21 percent in the quarter.
The company said that revenue gains in music publishing were more than offset by declines in U.S. and international sales of recorded music.

With its merger with Turner Broadcasting System behind it, Time Warner Chief Executive Gerald Levin said in a statement that the company is now focusing on integrating the businesses, improving its balance sheet, containing costs and improving its return on capital.
